(b) Secondary productivity is defined as rate of formation of new organic matter by heterotrophs 
(c) The annual net primary productivity of ocean is greater than land
(d) Tropical rain forest has maximum productivity.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is: 3. a, b, d
Explanation:

\t(a) Net primary productivity is available biomass for consumption to heterotrophs: True. NPP represents the energy that is available for consumption by herbivores and other heterotrophs after the plants' own respiration needs are met.
\t(b) Secondary productivity is defined as the rate of formation of new organic matter by heterotrophs: True. Secondary productivity refers to the biomass produced by consumers (heterotrophs) in the ecosystem.
\t(c) The annual net primary productivity of ocean is greater than land: False. The annual net primary· productivity (NPP) of terrestrial ecosystems is generally higher than that of oceans, although oceans cover a larger area.
\t(d) NCP decreases during succession: True. Net Community Productivity (NCP) typically decreases during ecological succession as the ecosystem matures and energy flow becomes less efficient.
